title: Saudi Arabian Chicken Fattoush
description: A Middle Eastern twist on the classic Italian bread salad, featuring saudi chicken and silky mozzarella.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper, and bake for 20 minutes or until cooked through.
In a large bowl, combine the arugula, mozzarella, flatbread crumbs, sumac, and salt and pepper to taste.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dal sauce, olive oil, and lemon juice.
Add the cooked chicken and the dal sauce mixture to the bowl and toss to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the chicken fattoush chilled, garnished with additional sumac and flatbread crumbs if desired.
Optional: add beans to the bowl for extra protein and fiber.
